scope: Primary-source screening; two autonomous mechanochemical models; no integration or chaos verification performed.
conclusion: One exact five-state source-audit target is ready to implement, with substantial prior-art qualifications. A second three-state model already has an explicit published chaotic example. Neither is claimed as a new attractor.

models.exact_scope: Equation S2 of arXiv:2504.19655v3 SI, also present in v1; explicit source choice f(L,t)=0; unsaturated single-cell ODE, not a spatially uniform reduction of the continuum PDE.

reference_equilibrium.meaning: Eref is a fixed uncoupled-equilibrium reference, called E0 in the source; it is not the initial E value.
reference_equilibrium.calculation: Unique real root of M^3-M^2+0.4*M-0.1=0; Eref=3*Mref/(Mref^2+0.1). Algebraic root computation only.

models.source_initialization: M,E on the uncoupled limit cycle; D=D0 and L=L0=1. Coupling enabled at t=0, then autonomous. No exact limit-cycle phase or numeric initial pair is asserted here.

exact_reparametrization.reconstruction: L=1-alpha*x; L0=1-alpha*y; beta=mu/alpha. Physical length admissibility still depends on alpha.

analytical_validation_control.condition: mu=0; stable planar chemical limit cycle with D=D0
analytical_validation_control.basis: Block-triangular variational system; driven linear mechanical filters.

physical_domain.chemical_positivity: M,E,D>=0 forward invariant: boundary derivatives a,b*M,D0/tauD.
physical_domain.length_positivity: L,L0>0 not automatically invariant; at L0=0, derivative is negative if E>Eref+1/alpha. Require alpha*x<1 and alpha*y<1 without clipping.
physical_domain.small_strain: Linear-elastic interpretation needs separate deformation checks.
physical_domain.fuel: Maintained chemical feed a and homeostatic source D0; not a closed finite-fuel model.

version_audit.v3_title: Symmetry-protected phases in a 1D active solid with mechanochemical feedback
version_audit.decisive_prior_art: Latest main text explicitly reports spatiotemporal chaos in phase II; supplementary section X discusses Lyapunov exponents. A first-chaos claim for the broad family is excluded.
version_audit.source_diagnostic_limit: Written QR description omits usual logged accumulated time-normalized factors, associates five exponents with component variables, and leaves full spatial versus local spectrum interpretation unclear. This does not prove the unseen code wrong.
version_audit.narrow_scope_unresolved: Whether the exact unsaturated autonomous single-cell S2 has an already published correctly verified chaotic parameter set remains unresolved. Spatial chaos is not automatically a result for S2.
version_audit.continuum_difference: The spatial model adds cubic saturation and has total-length-conserving mechanics, unlike S2 relaxation. Do not transfer boundedness or chaos between models.
